analysis.purpose: The test suite for enrich-provider — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: W7 loadProviders — structurally validate the user-owned providers file; W7 resolveProvider — guidance error when a name is absent; W7 providerConcurrency — default 1, clamped to [1, MAX]; W7 validateSaveItemShape — minimal contract a provider must honor.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of enrich-provider
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
